title: Unit 5: Screen Time: Conditionals with Conjunctions & Technology
objective: Mampu menggunakan struktur obligation, permission, dan prohibition untuk memberikan nasihat; menguasai bentuk necessity (didn't need to/needn't have); serta mengekspresikan ability in the past (could, was/were able to, managed to, succeeded in) dalam konteks teknologi dan screen time.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas tiga area gramatikal penting: (1) Obligation, permission, dan prohibition menggunakan have to, must, should, need to, dan be allowed to untuk memberikan nasihat dan aturan; (2) Necessity dengan didn't need to (tidak perlu melakukan sesuatu dan memang tidak dilakukan) vs needn't have done (tidak perlu melakukan tapi tetap dilakukan); (3) Ability in the past menggunakan could, was/were able to, managed to, dan succeeded in untuk menyatakan kemampuan umum atau pencapaian spesifik di masa lalu. Semua konsep ini diterapkan dalam konteks teknologi dan penggunaan layar.
rules: Obligation/Necessity: have to/must + infinitive (Most experts agree that screen time should be limited). Permission: be allowed to + infinitive. Prohibition: be not allowed to (Children aren't allowed to look at screens all the time).

Necessity: didn't need to + infinitive = tidak perlu dan tidak dilakukan (I didn't need to go to the stadium because I was able to watch it online). needn't have + past participle = tidak perlu tapi tetap dilakukan (You needn't have bought two tickets because I already had them).

Ability in the past - general: could/couldn't + infinitive (Many people couldn't even switch on a computer). Ability - specific achievement: was/were able to, managed to, succeeded in + gerund/noun (She managed to create a YouTube tutorial; He succeeded in making a rap video).
Had better = memberikan saran/peringatan, selalu diikuti base form verb (You had better turn off the TV if you don't want to get a headache).

Be supposed to = ada kewajiban/ekspektasi untuk melakukan sesuatu, tapi pada kenyataannya orang tidak selalu melakukannya. Selalu dalam bentuk passive (We're supposed to answer our phones whether we're at work, at home, or even asleep).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Couldn't vs Wasn't Able To
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering salah menggunakan couldn't untuk menyatakan ketidakmampuan dalam situasi spesifik yang berhasil diatasi. Couldn't digunakan untuk kemampuan umum atau kegagalan, sedangkan was/were able to, managed to, atau succeeded in digunakan untuk pencapaian spesifik di masa lalu.
commonTrap.wrong: After the IT lessons, they couldn't use computers confidently.
commonTrap.correct: After the IT lessons, they were able to use computers confidently. / They managed to use computers confidently.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Sheena dan Aaron tentang penggunaan gadget dan rencana akhir pekan

lines.speaker: Sheena
lines.text: Why did you miss the match on Saturday, Aaron?
lines.translation: Kenapa kamu tidak datang menonton pertandingan pada hari Sabtu, Aaron?

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.text: I've been spending a lot of time on my tablet recently. I think I've been becoming a bit addicted.
lines.translation: Aku sudah menghabiskan banyak waktu dengan tablet-ku akhir-akhir ini. Sepertinya aku jadi agak kecanduan.

lines.speaker: Sheena
lines.text: I understand. I've been staying up until midnight recently too, scrolling through social media.
lines.translation: Aku mengerti. Aku juga begadang sampai tengah malam akhir-akhir ini, scrolling media sosial.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.text: I wanted to warn you about hidden advertising or product placement in films. It's everywhere now.
lines.translation: Aku ingin memperingatkanmu tentang iklan tersembunyi atau penempatan produk dalam film. Sekarang itu ada di mana-mana.

lines.speaker: Sheena
lines.text: Thanks for the heads up. Hey, do you want to do an outdoor activity on Sunday instead of staying indoors?
lines.translation: Terima kasih sudah mengingatkan. Hei, apakah kamu mau melakukan kegiatan outdoor pada hari Minggu daripada di dalam ruangan?

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.text: That sounds great! Let's take a break from screens.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya bagus! Ayo kita istirahat dari layar.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor AI tentang screen time dan kebiasaan menggunakan teknologi

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi there! Today let's talk about screen time. Think of a screen that your parents complain about you using too much. What is it, and why do they complain about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, my parents often complain about me using my phone too much, especially before bedtime. They say I should put it down earlier.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a very common concern! Now, can you think of one type of screen that you couldn't live without and one you could live without? Tell me your reasons.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I couldn't live without my laptop because I need it for schoolwork and online classes. But I could definitely live without my tablet since I mainly just use it for entertainment.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent answer! You've thought this through well. One more question: do you think you manage to balance your screen time effectively, or do you feel you should improve? Why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think I need to improve. I often find myself staying up late because I can't stop browsing social media. I know I should set better limits.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's very honest and self-aware of you. Setting limits is definitely important. Well done on today's discussion! Keep practicing your English and thinking about how technology affects your life.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: Most experts agree that screen time _____ limited for young children.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'should be' untuk memberikan saran atau pendapat ahli. 'Should' diikuti oleh infinitive tanpa 'to', dan karena kalimatnya pasif, kita tambahkan 'be'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct form: You _____ buy two tickets because I already had them.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'needn't have + past participle' ketika seseorang melakukan sesuatu yang sebenarnya tidak perlu dilakukan. Faktanya orang tersebut sudah membeli tiket padahal tidak perlu.

quiz.question: After a few basic IT lessons, they _____ use computers confidently.
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyatakan pencapaian spesifik di masa lalu (mereka berhasil menggunakan komputer setelah les), gunakan 'were able to' atau 'managed to', bukan 'could' yang menyatakan kemampuan umum.

quiz.question: Complete with the correct word: I forgot to bring a UK _____, so I couldn't plug in my laptop.
quiz.explanation: Adaptor adalah perangkat yang digunakan untuk menghubungkan colokan dari satu negara ke stop kontak negara lain. Dalam konteks ini, butuh UK adaptor untuk mencolokkan laptop.

quiz.question: The 89-year-old woman _____ create a YouTube cooking tutorial after learning basic IT skills.
quiz.explanation: Untuk pencapaian spesifik yang sulit di masa lalu, gunakan 'managed to' atau 'succeeded in'. 'Could' tidak tepat untuk pencapaian spesifik, dan 'was succeeding' adalah bentuk continuous yang salah dalam konteks ini.

quiz.question: We're supposed _____ our phones whether we're at work or at home.
quiz.explanation: 'Be supposed to' selalu diikuti oleh infinitive (to + verb). Struktur ini menyatakan ekspektasi atau kewajiban yang seharusnya dilakukan.
